# HubSpot
HubSpot is an AI-native customer platform that unifies customer data, gives teams a complete view of every customer, and helps marketing, sales, service, and revenue teams act from one connected system. Available at https://www.hubspot.com. The platform is built around HubSpot Smart CRM - a central source of customer intelligence that combines structured data, conversations, and external signals - with Breeze as the AI layer that surfaces insights and automates action across every hub.
## Products
- [HubSpot Products Overview](https://www.hubspot.com/products): Full catalog of HubSpot products, features, and hubs
- [Customer Platform](https://www.hubspot.com/products/customer-platform): Single, connected architecture for marketing, sales, service, and revenue teams built on shared customer intelligence
- [Get Started](https://www.hubspot.com/products/get-started): Start using HubSpot's free tools and explore upgrade paths
## CRM
- [Smart CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm): AI-native CRM that unifies structured data, conversations, and external signals into a complete customer view - the shared system of record for every team
- [AI CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/ai-crm): HubSpot Smart CRM with AI-powered scoring, enrichment, and insights for a deeper view of every contact and company
- [Contact Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/contact-management): Store, organize, and enrich contact and company records in one shared database
- [Pipeline Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/pipeline-management): Visual deal pipelines with drag-and-drop stages, forecasting, and automation
- [Lead Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/lead-management): Capture, score, and route leads automatically from every source into Smart CRM
- [Live Chat](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/live-chat): Free live chat connected to CRM contacts for real-time sales and support conversations
- [Conversations Inbox](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/conversations): Shared team inbox for email, chat, and messaging channels connected to CRM
- [Data Enrichment](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/data-enrichment): Automatically enrich contact and company records with third-party data signals
- [Buyer Intent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/intent): Surface in-market prospects using buyer intent signals within Smart CRM
- [CRM Customization](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/customization): Custom properties, objects, and layouts to match your CRM to your business model
- [What is CRM](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/what-is): Guide to CRM software - what it is, how it works, and why teams use it
- [HubSpot Starter](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/starter): Entry-level customer platform for startups and small businesses
- [Chatbot Builder](https://www.hubspot.com/products/crm/chatbot-builder): Free chatbot builder to automate customer interactions without code
## Marketing Hub
- [Marketing Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing): Marketing software that activates customer intelligence from Smart CRM to run campaigns, generate leads, and attribute revenue - all without switching tools
- [Marketing Automation](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/marketing-automation): Automate email workflows, lead nurturing, and campaign triggers based on CRM behavior
- [Email Marketing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/email): Email marketing software with drag-and-drop editor and AI optimization
- [Newsletter Builder](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/newsletter-builder): Build, send, and analyze email newsletters connected to your CRM contacts
- [Ads Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/ads): Run and measure Facebook, Google, and LinkedIn ads with CRM audience sync
- [Analytics](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/analytics): Marketing analytics dashboards with multi-touch revenue attribution
- [Campaign Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/campaigns): Plan, execute, and report on multi-channel campaigns from one workspace
- [SEO Tools](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/seo): On-page SEO recommendations, topic clusters, and content strategy tools
- [Lead Scoring](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/lead-scoring): Automatically score leads based on engagement, fit, and behavioral signals
- [Lead Capture](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/lead-capture): Pop-ups, banners, and slide-in CTAs to convert website visitors into leads
- [Calls-to-Action](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/calls-to-action): Smart CTAs that personalize based on visitor properties from Smart CRM
- [SMS Marketing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/sms): Send and automate SMS campaigns connected to your CRM contact records
- [Social Media AI Agent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/social-media-ai-agent): AI agent for generating, scheduling, and optimizing social media posts
- [Social Media Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/social-inbox): Social media scheduling, monitoring, and reporting tools
- [Personalization](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/personalization): Personalize website content, emails, and CTAs using Smart CRM contact data
- [AEO for Marketing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/aeo): Marketing tools for optimizing content visibility in AI-generated search results
- [Landing Pages](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/landing-pages): Landing page builder with personalization and A/B testing
- [Forms](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/forms): Free online form builder with CRM sync and progressive profiling
- [Marketing Hub Free](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/free): Free Marketing Hub tools - email, forms, ads, and live chat at no cost
- [Marketing Hub Enterprise](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/enterprise): Enterprise-tier Marketing Hub with multi-touch attribution, custom objects, and advanced permissions
- [Blog Software](https://www.hubspot.com/products/marketing/blog-lp): Integrated blogging platform with SEO tools and AI writing assistance
## Sales Hub
- [Sales Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales): AI sales software that draws on Smart CRM's complete customer context to accelerate pipeline, prospecting, and deal execution from one connected system
- [AI Prospecting Agent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/ai-prospecting-agent): Breeze Prospecting Agent that automates outreach research and sequences
- [AI Guided Selling](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/ai-guided-selling): AI recommendations that guide reps on next best actions throughout the deal cycle
- [AI Sales Prospecting](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/ai-sales-prospecting): AI tools for identifying, researching, and prioritizing sales prospects at scale
- [Deal Pipeline](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/deal-pipeline): Manage and advance deals with visual pipelines, deal stages, and automation
- [Sales Automation](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/sales-automation): Automate follow-up sequences, task creation, and deal stage progressions
- [Playbooks](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/playbooks): In-CRM playbooks and call scripts to guide reps through consistent sales conversations
- [Document Tracking](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/document-tracking): Share sales documents and get notified when prospects open and view them
- [Meeting Scheduler](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/schedule-meeting): Free meeting scheduling tool that syncs with your calendar
- [Email Tracking](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/email-tracking): Know when prospects open emails and click links in real time
- [Email Templates](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/email-templates-sales): Reusable sales email templates with personalization tokens
- [Sales Lead Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/sales/sales-leads): Lead management and prospecting software with AI prioritization
## Service Hub
- [Service Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service): AI-powered customer service platform that uses the complete customer view from Smart CRM to route, resolve, and retain customers across every channel
- [Help Desk](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/help-desk): AI-powered help desk software for ticket routing and resolution
- [Omnichannel Customer Service](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/omnichannel-customer-service): Manage customer conversations across email, chat, phone, and messaging in one inbox
- [Automated Customer Service](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/automated-customer-service): Automate ticket routing, escalations, and follow-ups using CRM-based rules
- [AI Knowledge Base Agent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/ai-knowledge-base-agent): AI agent that creates and maintains knowledge base articles from resolved tickets
- [Customer Portal](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/customer-portal): Self-service portal for customers to view and manage their support tickets
- [Ticketing System](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/ticketing-system): Free ticketing software to track, prioritize, and resolve support issues
- [Knowledge Base](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/knowledge-base): Self-service knowledge base builder to reduce inbound support volume
- [Customer Feedback](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/customer-feedback): CSAT, NPS, and CES survey tools with closed-loop follow-up
- [Customer Success Management](https://www.hubspot.com/products/service/customer-success-management): Tools to manage health scores, renewals, and expansion revenue
## Content Hub (CMS)
- [Content Hub](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content): Content marketing software for blogs, landing pages, and brand consistency
- [Brand Voice](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/brand-voice): Define and enforce consistent brand voice across all AI-generated content
- [Content Repurposing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/content-repurposing-software): Repurpose long-form content into social posts, clips, and summaries automatically
- [Video Marketing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/video-marketing): Host, embed, and track video content connected to CRM engagement data
- [Podcast Software](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/podcast-software): Publish and manage podcasts with HubSpot's content management tools
- [Blog](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/blog): Blog hosting and management within Content Hub with built-in SEO tools
- [Case Study Generator](https://www.hubspot.com/products/content/case-study-generator): AI tool for generating customer case study drafts from key inputs
- [CMS Tools](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms): Free CMS tools for building and managing a website on HubSpot
- [Website Builder](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/drag-and-drop-website-builder): Drag-and-drop website builder with themes, SEO, and CRM integration
- [Web Hosting](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/web-hosting): Free web hosting with SSL, CDN, and 99.99% uptime SLA
- [CMS AI Content Writer](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/ai-content-writer): AI content generator for blog posts, web copy, and marketing assets
- [CMS AI Blog Writer](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/ai-blog-writer): AI blog writer embedded in CMS for generating drafts and optimizing posts
- [Blog Maker](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/free-blog-maker): Free blog creation tool with built-in SEO recommendations
- [AI Website Generator](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/ai-website-generator): Generate a full business website from a prompt using AI
- [Custom Domain Connection](https://www.hubspot.com/products/cms/custom-domain-connection): Connect a custom domain to your HubSpot website for free
## AI & Breeze
- [Breeze AI](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence): The AI layer across the HubSpot customer platform - Breeze surfaces customer intelligence, automates workflows, and powers AI agents embedded in every hub
- [Breeze AI Agents](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/breeze-ai-agents): Autonomous AI agents for prospecting, content creation, and customer support that act on shared CRM context without manual handoffs
- [Breeze Assistant](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/breeze-ai-assistant): Shared AI assistant embedded across all HubSpot tools that helps every team understand customer context and take action faster
- [AI Customer Service Agent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/ai-customer-service-agent): AI customer agent that resolves tickets and qualifies leads autonomously using the full customer history from Smart CRM
- [AI Use Cases](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/use-cases): Full index of Breeze AI use cases across marketing, sales, and service teams
- [AI Use Cases - Marketing](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/use-cases/marketing): How Breeze AI accelerates campaign planning, content creation, and lead generation
- [AI Use Cases - Sales](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/use-cases/sales): How HubSpot AI accelerates sales prospecting, outreach, and forecasting
- [AI Use Cases - Service](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/use-cases/service): How HubSpot AI automates support, routing, and customer success workflows
- [AI Trust](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/ai-trust): HubSpot's approach to responsible AI - transparency, data privacy, and model governance
- [AI Social](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/ai-social): AI social media post generator for creating and scheduling content
- [AI Data Agent](https://www.hubspot.com/products/artificial-intelligence/ai-data-agent): AI agent for querying and surfacing insights from your HubSpot
